meta.name: BBC's Walking With series [576p quality]
meta.description:
📦 Origem: Internet Archive (coleção aberta — confira a licença)

Explore the full spectrum of life before our time with BBC's award-winning Walking With… series, which has captivated audiences all over the world with breathtaking digital effects and animatronics.  Now relive the thrills from the rise of monsters millions of years ago to the reign of dinosaurs, beasts and our own evolutionary predecessors.  The end of that era is only the beginning!

- All videos taken from 576p quality PAL DVDs, the highest resolution released anywhere.

Series includes:
- Walking With Dinosaurs (1999)
- The Ballad of Big Al [aka Allosaurs: A Walking With Dinosaurs special] (2000)
- Walking With Beasts [aka Walking With Prehistoric Beasts] (2001)
- Chased By Dinosaurs: The Giant Claw & Land of Giants (2002)
- Walking With Cavemen (2003)
- Sea Monsters: A Walking With Dinosaurs Trilogy [aka Chased by Sea Monsters] (2003)
- *Walking With Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs [aka Before The Dinosaurs] (2005)

*This is an extended version with all three episodes edited together along with additional scenes and footage
